crossRefs.note: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

translations.web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
translations.bsb: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
translations.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing
translations.asv: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.
